KIVI implements a plug-and-play quantization algorithm that compresses KV caches without requiring model fine-tuning. The system achieves memory optimization through asymmetric quantization strategies: per-channel quantization for key caches and per-token quantization for value caches.

# Overview

## Purpose and Scope

This document introduces KIVI (Key-Value Input Vectorization), a tuning-free asymmetric quantization system for KV caches in Large Language Models. KIVI reduces memory usage by quantizing key and value caches to 2-bit or 4-bit precision while maintaining model performance through strategic residual management and custom GPU acceleration.
